mechanism: Both drugs have CNS effects and psychiatric adverse event profiles; mefloquine can cause neuropsychiatric toxicity (anxiety, depression, psychosis, seizures) which may be compounded by varenicline's neurological effects and potential to lower seizure threshold.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if antimalarial therapy is necessary, consider alternative agents (atovaquone-proguanil or artemether-lumefantrine); monitor closely for neuropsychiatric symptoms, seizures, and CNS toxicity if co-administration is unavoidable.
